gaps.lead: 'I've never been to Asia,' she told me.
gaps.sentence: She told me that ___ to Asia.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect shifts to past perfect in reported speech.

gaps.lead: His trainers were so worn out that they had holes in them.
gaps.sentence: His trainers were ___ they had holes in them.
gaps.explanation: so worn out = in such bad condition.

gaps.lead: Somebody is repairing our roof at the moment.
gaps.explanation: Somebody else is doing it for us: we are having our roof repaired.

gaps.lead: We wanted to continue our mountain trek but the weather was too bad.
gaps.sentence: We ___ on with our mountain trek but the weather was too bad.
gaps.hint: unfulfilled wish: would have liked to
gaps.explanation: An unrealised wish about the past: 'would have liked to carry on'.

gaps.lead: Phoebe was surprised to be offered a place on the course.
gaps.sentence: The offer of a place on the course ___ Phoebe.
gaps.hint: surprised by = come as a surprise to
gaps.explanation: 'Was surprised' becomes 'came as a surprise to her'.

gaps.lead: After a year in Paris, the pace of life feels normal to her.
gaps.sentence: She ___ the pace of life in Paris.
gaps.explanation: get used to + noun/-ing = become accustomed to; present perfect for present result.
